steps.content:
An hour ago
Belphegor Art Museum - Gate of Hell
You finally find a... "human" in the depths of the museum.
A thin, blue-clad woman leans her back against the dark gate with her eyes closed, like she's pondering something.
Hearing your footsteps, she opens her eyes to meet yours, not yet able to adjust the stony expression on her face.
At the same time, the navigator on you starts talking.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: This is unexpected. Fate is unpredictable indeed. Please allow me to introduce myself, Enfer, an Eastside artist. I specialize in sculpting but occasionally dab in other art forms like oil paintings.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Well, that's about it. There's not much else about this person. Everything interesting about her is in her works. For example, the one in front of us...
You turn off the navigator. The imitated voice sounds ridiculous in front of the original.

Since the mutation broke out, you have been fighting Mania creatures alone and significantly weakened. With the shackles, you can sense 5 Sinners coming to rescue you, but you can't reach them due to the contamination.

After pursuing the source of the mutation alone for quite some time, you finally meet this woman, the exhibition's creator. Enfer straightens herself to face you. The gloom on her face is gone, and she shows a bright smile.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: It's nice to see you. I thought there was no one else here.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You are unaffected by the mutation and not a captive of fear... Who are you, dear friend?

options: I should be asking that question. Who are you?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: The navigator just introduced me. I'm Enfer, a sculptor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I watched as the place was cordoned off, and people were captured by fear. The visitors and staff were all crushed and turned into exhibits, part of Witching Hour—except you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not affected by the mutation, and all your works are twisting and turning into monsters that terrorize everyone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not just any artist can have that kind of power. Who are you really?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Hehe, you are good at analyzing. Are you an inspector? Hmm... You look more like an expert in dealing with these bizarre phenomena. You won't be affected by them, you have the power to defeat the monsters, and you are not afraid.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You are alone but determined and confident to solve everything... You must still have something special up your sleeves.

options: Your analysis is not bad either.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Thanks. Observation, imagination, and interpretation are all required to be a good artist.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I know what you suspect, but please don't assume I'm behind this because I'm spared. This exhibition is for my cherished works, and I would never do anything to harm them.

options: Then you better have an explanation for me.

steps.content: You step closer to her, doing your best to look intimidating while subtly reducing your distance.
Enfer notices and smiles, but it looks glossy and vain. She seems inscrutable as her art.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I'm known as the <color=#fb9259>Witch of Fear</color> in the art world, specializing in inspiring fear with my works. In Eastside, people love the excitement, just like they love horror movies and haunted houses.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: The art of horror stimulates people's imagination, giving them the thrill of racing heartbeats without causing any harm. They enjoy the thrill and then go back to a peaceful life. No one ever took it too seriously.

options: But the imagined fear is becoming reality.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Yes. If you think the shadows are moving, they will start haunting you in a few seconds. If you suspect someone is behind you, soon there will be whispering in your ears.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: People began to panic about being trapped when the first person screamed that the main entrance was blocked. Their words became a reality, and no one has been able to get out of Belphegor Museum since...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>People's fear turning into reality</color>, this is the truth of Witching Hour.

options: And your works triggered the fear.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Excellent artists use their works to convey emotions and connect with the inner worlds of the audience, triggering empathy, imagination, and reflection.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But that's about it. I'm just a sculptor who became famous by chance. I don't have the power to affect so many people.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your works are attached with a strange power, and the fear they induce is beyond the common sense of empathy... It's Mania, and that makes you a Sinner.
You take another step forward, getting close enough to grab Enfer's wrist by surprise.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Ouch, that hurts. What...
The moment you touch her bare skin, the shackles start working. You got her!
But it feels strange... You can clearly sense her power through the shackles, and it's surprisingly...
...Weak.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: It's so hot. Please let go. Don't hurt the hand of an artist.
Enfer is not strong enough to break free. She's pinned on the cold dark gate and doesn't even have the strength to loosen your fingers.
B-class? No, not even that. No wonder the Eastside monitoring network didn't issue a warning. She's not even as strong as Hella. Such a Sinner couldn't have triggered this huge mutation.
Just then, another force sends a shiver down your spine. It's not from the Sinner before you, but...
The <color=#fb9259>grand dark stone gate</color> Enfer is leaning on.
You're too close to see the whole of it, but a vast and complete obsidian gate stands before you. It's flat as a mirror, and the darkness reminds you of an abyss.

And something is surging in there. A dark mist is wrapped around your reflection in the mirror, slowly taking the form of a human. The familiar voice and feeling are overflowing with madness and destruction. At that moment, your soul is seized by fear.
...Surrender...
Surrender... to the shackles...
...Oh no, you've been so focused on the Sinner before you that you overlooked her works. This gate is also a sculpture Enfer made to trigger fear!
Surrender to me!!!
It reaches out violently and actually passes through the gate, becoming solid.
That hand burns with the light of shackles, and its head is encircled with a red halo. The phantom's face is shrouded, but you know this monster is you, the crazed you!

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Close your eyes!
The woman takes the opportunity to break free, dragging you to the cloister without looking back.
The shackles monster retreats, but its power lingers in the space. It's still hovering in front of the gate, squeezing your heart to death with each pacing step.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Even I was afraid to look directly at that gate, and you just stared at it and created something horrible.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The Gate of Hell</color>, something that I was quite satisfied with in my early years. It can evoke one's deepest fear.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You are afraid of the mystery and power in you, of losing control, failing, and being alone... The fear has been awakened by the Gate of Hell and turned into reality by Witching Hour.

options: Make it stop. I forbid you to activate your power.

steps.content: You gasp but still struggle to voice your command. Crimson spikes sprout on Enfer's wrist, and she winces in pain. The forbidden force of the shackles has been activated—but nothing changes.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: So this is the shackles that that version of you is talking about... Is this something Sinners can't resist?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Hehe, no wonder my heart skipped a beat when I saw you. My instinct was telling me to fear you.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: It won't work. I don't have the power to turn fear into reality. I didn't create Witching Hour, and its real master is behind the Gate of Hell.

options: Are you going to let it be?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your works are all twisted because of Witching Hour, and the exhibition is ruined. If it continues, you will be affected sooner or later. You should help stop this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you can help solve this incident, I won't tell on you being a Sinner. You won't be detained and can keep being a free artist.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You could just say that you need my help, because I will help.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I created every single piece of artwork here, and I'm the only one who can destroy them.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But you must first beat that version of <color=#fb9259>you</color>. That's not my creation but yours.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Well, Mr Expert, let's see how you fight your own fear.
steps.female_content: Well, Miss Expert, let's see how you fight your own fear.

steps.content: You struggle to calm your breathing and brace yourself, only to be interrupted by a blast.
The terrifying phantom unleashed a powerful Potestas that shattered the wall, and the second blow is on its way.

You want to stand up and fight, but your feet won't oblige. Your will is suppressed, and the shackles feel weak. Is this the power of Witching Hour? When you are afraid of something, you will never be able to defeat it.

steps.speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Surrender... to me!!!
The raging power of Potestas is released, but not toward you, and a familiar wail comes from the other direction.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ahhhh, help! Chief, stop this. It's me, EMP! Ah!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Keep your head clear. That's not the Chief. It's just a phantom born from fear.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What fear phantom? Which one of you idiots is scared again? Who is afraid of that numbnut?!
There are banging sounds, accompanied by the sound of breaking porcelain. You see a group of familiar people barge to the dark gate, actively or forced to face the berserk phantom.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: There are others who can get this deep... Are they also Sinners?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: As long as it's the shackles' request, even with fear in their hearts, they cannot refuse and must come to rescue you?

options: I would never give them such commands.

steps.content: You stop talking to her. With your long-lost companions here, your feet start to move, and you rush toward the phantom that once terrified you. There's only one thing on your mind—You can't let it hurt the Sinners!

options: Don't be afraid! That's not something you should fear!

steps.content: Powerful energy rushes out of the darkness, repelling your enemy. The shackles are back, blazing in the palm of your hand.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: ...I see. Other feelings in your heart have weakened the power of fear.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I'm not even close...

steps.speaker: Hecate & Hella
steps.content:
Chief!
What took you so long?!
You think for a moment.

options: I've been waiting for you too.
The protagonist always shows up at final critical moments.

steps.content: The fear vanishes, and the shackles finally return to the Sinners.
